scope: Finite independent read-only review of four number/date cookbook pages, written core/model examples and number-recipes ledger only

semantic_checks.evidence: Whole-value positive decimal regex and pattern-specific identity guard preserve nonmatches; total extraction precedes shortening TRACK, and reversed order loses the source total as documented. One-value and double-backslash exclusions match Format Value output rules. TRACKTOTAL is custom, while MP4 TOTALTRACKS shares trkn and persists when only the current number changes; simultaneous conflicting native totals and u16 bounds are accurately qualified.

Actual selected list order drives adjacent folder transitions, not global folder grouping. Shortcut overrides directory transition/reset and disc writing but does not clear remembered field resets, which the instructions explicitly clear. Total is the final assigned number of each run; start5/count3 yields7. Partial/interleaved examples match core. Preview limit100 and reviewed-plan invalidation match frontend; Stage numbers updates drafts and Save writes, with selection-autosave caveat.

Immediate _DIRECTORY context, case-insensitive CD prefix, permitted separators/leading zeros and positive whole-value capture match the expression. The guard avoids writing a nonmatching folder name, preserves the existing single-value fallback and excludes double-backslash splitting. No total/rename/ancestor lookup is claimed; literal Guess Values alternative is accurately distinguished.

Left4 examples preserve the significant trailing space in May . Whole-value regex action processes each current YEAR value, leaves nonmatches/timestamps unchanged and extracts four digits from invalid-calendar-shaped input, as explicitly taught. Storage/read-back/player and immediate-action vs saved-workflow limits are preserved.

ledger.bounds: Local112/75 drafts and public97/90 drafts are separated; no universal native storage, player, native UI or canonical semantic-completeness claim. Browser evidence is local-only author evidence, not publication proof.

independently_executed.provenance: Existing binary supplied by guide owner for exact immutable checkpoint; no cold build/Cargo invocation. Reads compiled actual Markdown fences/tables, executes actual ordered actions/numbering core under LF/CRLF, including reverse-order and interleaved-run controls.

Exact immutable test, numbering-review.ts and recipe strings; temporary loader changes only TypeScript dependency path and source/document reads. Exercises actual defaults, shortcut total mode, disabled entered-total callback, begin/complete/take and selection-order invalidation.

limits: No repository edits, source/P2 fixes, commits, push, PR/publishing/review requests or CI.
No full suite/cold rebuild, fresh canonical recrawl, native application save/Undo, real cross-platform storage or player compatibility test.
Prior customization/basic/cleanup batches are preserved parents, not re-audited here.
Finite peer review is not GitHub CODE approval or queue authorization.
